knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A wall holding a neighbour's ground and a driveway load is a structural matter. It is referred and held until advice is given, rather than quoted as landscape work.
The one-metre exemption is recorded from Victoria's building authority practice note only. Other jurisdictions and councils are not covered here, and advice may still be needed.
A referral gives the site facts and the client's purpose so the qualified person can assess the wall. It does not contain a structural design or a construction price.

practicalCriteria: Given a supplied mock site plan with a level change, a neighbour's ground and a driveway load, the learner marks each referral trigger on the plan within the assessor's set time.
The learner writes a referral note for the mock wall that includes the site description, measurements, drainage and surcharge observations, without proposing a structural design.
The learner states, in role-play, the written message to the client about the referral and why no wall work starts before advice is received.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Annotated mock site plan signed by the assessor.
Referral note for the mock wall, reviewed by the assessor.
Assessor observation record of the client role-play.
stopWorkCriteria: Starting any wall excavation or footing work during the assessment.
Producing a structural design or wall dimensions for construction during the assessment.
